description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single hybrid attacks (0.90 or 457.50 each) capped at 19999, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Tri-Element Mode II (Fire, Lightning, Water)], [Dual Awoken Ninja Mode I (Edge)] and [Ninja Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Tri-Element Mode II (Fire, Lightning, Water)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking]/[Attach Water with Stacking] after using a Fire/Lightning/Water ability

description.name: Dual Awoken Ninja Mode I (Edge)
description.text: Ninja abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ninja abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Eblan Style after using three equipped Ninja abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Ninja Mode II (Edge)], removes [Dual Awoken Ninja Mode I (Edge)]
